answer: Each identity must keep 400 credits locked in the ferrous vault while active, and the saffron board publishes balances each epoch. A fable log records random checkpoint snapshots, so anyone can recompute board against vault. The balance must sit untouched for two epochs before it counts, and a shortfall burns 100 credits. The k-th fake locks 400, so 1,000 fakes lock 400,000 with no sharing. A fund-passing ring fails because one pot seasons only one identity per two epochs, so passing 400 through 1,000 identities takes 2,000 epochs. An honest agent locks 400 once and reclaims it on leaving.
